build_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: build a python module to generate a radius graph with PBC using NVIDIA nvalchemiops acceleration
create_get_neighbors_nvidia: create a function that performs nearest neighbor search on atomic positions with periodic boundary conditions using NVIDIA GPU
create_get_neighbors_nvidia_atoms: create a function that finds neighbors for an ASE Atoms object using NVIDIA nvalchemiops and returns edge indices and distances
refactor_get_neighbors_nvidia_batched: refactor the get_neighbors_nvidia function to support batched molecular structures with per-structure atom counts
test_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: test the radius_graph_pbc_nvidia function with a data object containing positions, cell, natoms, and PBC attributes
